items.title: Tank Dell: Week 1 status unclear
items.body_text: Dell said, "I'm taking it one day at a time" when asked Friday about his potential availability for Week 1 of the regular season versus Buffalo, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyjae Spears: Exits practice early Friday
items.body_text: Spears is dealing with some soreness and irritation, which caused him to depart practice early Friday, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: DNP again Friday
items.body_text: Jacobs (groin) isn't practicing Friday, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Harbaugh downplays exit from practice
items.body_text: Coach John Harbaugh said Skattebo's early exit from Friday's practice is "nothing serious at all," Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Rotates with Rodriguez in scrimmage
items.body_text: During Friday's scrimmage, Tuten started the first drive with the Jaguars' offense with LeQuint Allen mixing in on third down, then Chris Rodriguez started the second drive before rotating with Tuten, John Shipley of SI.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
